svg.title: BAFQMC: symmetry-protected access to frustrated bosons

cc:Work.dc:title: BAFQMC: symmetry-protected access to frustrated bosons
cc:Work.dc:description: Offset upper and right half-planes with two physical motifs only: an HS transformation into a fixed-field bosonic scene in the frustrated TRS/RP region and four equal interacting bosons in the unfrustrated local-weight region.
